articles.description: The Maple Leafs acquired Aatu Räty, sending Jacob Quillan and Brandon Buhr to Vancouver.

articles.headline: Senators' William Eklund set to miss 10-12 weeks after ankle surgery
articles.description: Senators forward William Eklund is expected to be out 10 to 12 weeks after undergoing surgery to repair a torn tendon in his ankle suffered last week against the Flyers.

images.credit: Photo by Richard A. Whittaker/Icon Sportswire

articles.headline: Arizona State hockey coach exits amid probe into collapse; Dave Hakstol hired
articles.description: Arizona State hockey coach Greg Powers has left the program amid a probe into a player's collapse. Avalanche assistant Dave Hakstol was hired as the new coach.

articles.headline: Stanley Cup odds: Flyers, Red Wings see futures tumble after lousy starts
articles.description: The Carolina Hurricanes are favorites to win the 2027 Stanley Cup while other teams drop after three weeks.

images.name: Owen Tippett [1296x729]
images.caption: Owen Tippett and the Philadelphia Flyers are off to the worst start in franchise history.

images.name: Matthew Tkachuk [1296x729]
images.caption: Two-time champ Matthew Tkachuk and the Florida Panthers are among the leaders to win the Stanley Cup.

images.name: Carolina Hurricanes [1296x729]
images.caption: The Carolina Hurricanes are co-favorites to repeat as Stanley Cup champions.

articles.headline: After offseason chaos, the Red Wings have an 'us against the world' mentality
articles.description: A captain's trade request, a key young player's holdout and a resigned general manager. Here's how the Red Wings are holding it all together.

images.name: Red Wings [1296x729]
images.credit: Allan Dranberg/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images

images.name: Moritz Seider [1296x729]
images.caption: "It's us against the rest of the world," defenseman Moritz Seider said. "That's something we've learned pretty fast."

images.caption: Dylan Larkin nets goal for Red Wings
